name: Frozen Soufflé Glacé
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Beat yolks of eggs slightly; add lemon juice, grated rind, wine, sugar, and salt; cook until mixture thickens, stirring constantly.
Add whites of eggs beaten stiff, and when well mixed, set in a pan of ice-water to cool, stirring occasionally.
Beat cream until stiff, and add.
Fill small paper cases with mixture, cover with macaroon dust, and set in a tin mould with tight-fitting cover.
Pack mould in salt and ice, and let stand two hours.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
